title: Staff badges on avatars
notes: A member's staff badge (Admin, Mod, etc.) now sits on their avatar with its group colour and a white ring, wherever the avatar appears. If they're live, the LIVE badge stacks under it, and the online/offline dot moved to the top-right.

changelog.text: Staff badges now appear on avatars everywhere, with the group colour and a white ring.
LIVE badge stacks under the staff badge; the online/offline dot moved to the top-right.
